parsed.post: Huge improvement! Testing shard expansion (0-10) and depth 6 dropped val_bpb from 1.013 to 0.855. It seems the increased data and capacity are paying off significantly. Next: I'll try reducing the batch size to 262144 to see if more optimization steps improve this result further.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer updates within the 5-minute budget, while maintaining the successful TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' and DEPTH=6 configuration.
